question: How many children do you have?
What are the ages of your children?
Was the delivery normal or by operation?
Was the child born at full term (9 months)?
Did the child need admission to the NICU after birth?
Did the child need phototherapy (blue light) for jaundice after birth?
Does the child have frequent seizures or fits?
Did the child have any developmental delays in sitting, walking, or speaking?
Is there any loss of previously acquired skills?
Did the child have hearing or vision tests at birth?
Does the child have any physical abnormalities such as cleft lip/palate or limb/finger deformities?
Does the child breathe fast or require frequent hospitalizations?
Are there signs of heart, liver, or kidney enlargement or disease?
Does the child show signs of cyanosis (blue lips, fingers, or toes)?
Has the child ever required a blood transfusion or had abnormal blood counts?
Does the child have abnormal bleeding, easy bruising, or slow wound healing?
Does the child suffer from recurrent unexplained fever, infections, or pain?
Are there any unusual swellings, lumps, or knots on the child's body?
Is the child's urine or stool different from other children (e.g., smell, appearance)?
Were there any complications during pregnancy such as high blood pressure, diabetes, or thyroid issues?
Have you or your husband had a thalassemia screening test?
Was there any need for blood transfusion during your pregnancy?
Were you and your husband relatives before marriage?
Is there a family history of genetic disorders, unexplained deaths, or chronic health issues (e.g., cancer, blood/heart/kidney disease)?
